No map S→P(S) is onto; singleton injection gives strict comparison.

text_only_followup.before: Godel's second incompleteness theorem says a consistent system strong enough for arithmetic cannot prove its own consistency. Gentzen nonetheless published a proof that Peano arithmetic is consistent. Decide how both can stand.
text_only_followup.after: For a consistent effectively axiomatized arithmetic theory with the standard arithmetized provability conditions, Gödel’s second incompleteness theorem excludes an internal proof of its usual consistency sentence. Gentzen nevertheless gave an external consistency proof for PA. How can both results stand?
text_only_followup.verification: Replacing the one new JSON string with the old one reconstructs exactly the owner-reader curriculum hash. All browser-reviewed JS/CSS/shared runtime bytes remain unchanged.
